verdict.rationale: Anytype's documented Web Publishing lets you pick an Object and click Publish inside the app. It then generates a static HTML page on your personal <your-id>.any.org subdomain, so selected notes can become public webpages without leaving the app. The evidence only covers single-object pages, though, and never shows that published notes link to one another as a browsable digital garden. missing for 10: evidence that links between published notes resolve to other published pages, multi-page site navigation or structure, independent or hands-on corroboration of publishing.
